[Section] Data Collection ::: Annotating Tweets ::: HATE SPEECH (HS):
[source_id=25] Hate speech tweets, a subset of offensive tweets containing offensive language targeting group based on common characteristics such as: Race, ex: يا زنجي> (“yA znjy” – “O negro”); Ethnicity, ex. الفرس الأنجاس> (“Alfrs AlAnjAs” – “Impure Persians”); Group or party, ex: أبوك شيوعي> (“Abwk $ywEy” – “your father is communist”); and Religion, ex: دينك القذر> (“dynk Alq*r” – “your filthy religion”).
